title: Storm Sorceress at Sea
description: A powerful female sorceress with purple hair and a glowing crown stands on the bow of a wooden longship during a violent storm. She holds a glowing magical staff as ethereal dragon spirits swirl around her, while Viking warriors battle on stormy seas filled with sinking ships and crashing waves under a swirling vortex sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful sorceress with flowing purple hair and a jeweled crown standing on the prow of a Viking longship in a turbulent stormy sea. She holds a tall ornate staff emitting green and blue magical energy, surrounded by ethereal glowing dragon-like spirits swirling in the air. Multiple longships are visible in the background with Viking warriors fighting amidst crashing purple waves and heavy rain. The sky features a massive swirling vortex of dark clouds with orange and cyan energy at the center, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting style.
